name: MAH AI Hub: Robotics & IoT Command
tag: AI agents find and fix faults across robots and IoT devices, and log every case.

scenarios.title: Fix a robot arm that stops mid-cycle
scenarios.ask: {stops} of our {robots} pick-and-place arms stop mid-cycle a few times a shift. Find the cause.
steps: Collector
Pulled controller logs, motor currents and safety events from {robots} arms.
Diagnostician
Affected arms show a torque spike on joint 3 just before each stop.
Root cause
Grease on joint 3 is past its service interval. The others were serviced last month.
Fixer
Lowered joint 3 speed by 10% as a stopgap and booked service for the affected arms.
Case log
Opened a case with logs, charts and the fix for each arm.
followups: Does the AI change robot settings on its own?
Only inside limits you set, like a small speed cut. Anything bigger waits for an engineer to approve.
Will it find this sooner next time?
Yes. The case trains a watch rule, so a rising joint torque raises a service ticket before the arm stops.

scenarios.title: Stop sensor dropouts
scenarios.ask: {drop} of our {sensors} IoT sensors drop offline each day. Fix it.
steps: Scanner
Found {=round(sensors * drop / 100)} sensors dropping each day.
Diagnostician
{=round(drop * 5)}% of dropouts happen on batteries under 3.0 volts.
Network check
The rest cluster on one gateway with a weak signal.
Fixer
Raised the reporting interval on low-battery units and opened a battery swap list.
Case log
Logged one case per root cause with the affected devices.
followups: It drafts the order and the swap route. A person approves the purchase.
Interval changes apply in minutes. Battery swaps follow your field schedule.

scenarios.title: Review the monthly case log
scenarios.ask: Summarize last month's {cases} cases for our {fleets} fleets.
steps: Reader
Read {cases} cases across {fleets} fleet(s), with causes and fixes.
Grouper
Grouped them into {=min(12, 3 + floor(cases / 40))} root-cause families.
Analyst
{=round(cases * 0.45)} cases came from the top 3 causes.
Writer
Drafted a 1-page summary with 3 prevention actions.
followups: Yes. Each case keeps the evidence, every action taken and who approved it.
Yes. Any device with the same fault twice in 30 days is flagged for a deeper fix.
